answers.sql:
SELECT
    ch.CHNL_K,
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN tx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON tx.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.BR_K,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-08-31';

SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    cc.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON rt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc ON rt.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY cc.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    d.MKT_K,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MKT_K
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT
    d_acct.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT d_acct
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d_acct.OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d_acct.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY accounts_opened_2025 DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(mid_rt) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

answers.sql:
SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

-- Count customers with no account transaction in 2025
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) , 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
  ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.DTCTN_AT) = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

-- Total outstanding loan principal on 31‑Dec‑2025 by loan product
WITH disb AS (
    SELECT d.LN_PRD_K,
           SUM(d.PRNCP_AMT) AS total_disbursed
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K
),
rep AS (
    SELECT r.LN_PRD_K,
           SUM(r.PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS total_repaid
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON r.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY r.LN_PRD_K
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       COALESCE(d.total_disbursed,0) - COALESCE(r.total_repaid,0) AS outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN disb d ON p.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
LEFT JOIN rep r ON p.LN_PRD_K = r.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = TRUE
ORDER BY outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT d.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.RGN_CD1, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY d.RGN_CD1, atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT d.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
       SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

-- Count distinct customers who were in default at the end of August 2025

    SELECT MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS last_date
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-08-31'
),
    default_at_date AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
    JOIN last_aug_date lad ON f.BUS_DT_K = lad.last_date

)

  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

-- Drop the fact_complaint table
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT
    cc.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(CAST(f.STLM_AMT AS NUMERIC(20,4))) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc ON f.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
    ch.CHNL_K,
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
 WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
 GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
 ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    br.BR_K,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

-- Count distinct customers who were in default at the end of August 2025
WITH last_aug_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(d.DT_K) AS dt_k
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_DT <= '2025-08-31'
),
    default_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
    JOIN last_aug_date lad ON f.BUS_DT_K = lad.dt_k
    WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_default_clients
FROM default_customers;

SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    d.CCY_K,
    c.CCY_NM,
    AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN
    bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE
    d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
    d.CCY_K,
    c.CCY_NM
ORDER BY
    d.CCY_K;

SELECT
    f.MKT_ID,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY f.MKT_ID
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transactions DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
 WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
   AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
 ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

-- Count customers with no account transaction in 2025
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED') / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH date_key AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
  disb AS (
    SELECT d.LN_PRD_K, SUM(f.PRNCP_AMT) AS total_disbursed
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
    JOIN date_key dk ON f.BUS_DT_K <= dk.DT_K
    GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K
  ),
  pay AS (
    SELECT d.LN_PRD_K, SUM(f.PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS total_paid
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT f
    JOIN date_key dk ON f.BUS_DT_K <= dk.DT_K
    GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K
  )
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       COALESCE(d.total_disbursed,0) - COALESCE(p.total_paid,0) AS outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN disb d ON p.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K;

SELECT
  br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
    f.MRCH_CTG_K,
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_K
ORDER BY total_txn_amt DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d_cust.BUS_ID,
       SUM(f_wr_trf.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f_wr_trf.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_cust.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    cc.CCY_NM AS currency,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc ON f.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.CCY_NM
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w USING (CUST_K);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT
  cc.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(CAST(f.STLM_AMT AS NUMERIC(20,4))) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc ON f.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
